_note: Lib-agnostic source catalog extracted from the S578 prototype. Nested keys work as-is with next-intl namespaces or a plain lookup helper. {name} is a runtime interpolation (the channel name). Keep operator-facing strings ONLY here; no string ships as a literal in the UI.

stage1.title: Connect your rental sites
stage1.sub: Connect each website once. Then Vacantless helps you post to all of them from one place.
stage1.kindLogin: You use your own account for this site. Vacantless writes the ad and keeps the link; it never signs in as you.

status.linkedSub: Ready to automatically send your listings.
status.notLinkedSub: Connect once and we can post here for you.
status.notAvailableSub: We are still building this connection. Nothing to do here yet.
status.mlsOnlySub: Realtor.ca is not a direct post. We prepare the sheet for your agent.
status.connectedNeedsAuthSub: Signed in as {label}. Authorize Vacantless before it can post here.
status.checkingSub: Looking at your {name} account. This takes under a minute.
status.deadSessionSub: Your {name} session ended ({reason}). Sign in again to continue.
status.linkedSubLogin: Your account is on file. We write the ad and keep the link; you post it, or ask us to post it for you.
status.notLinkedSubLogin: Tell us which account you use. We write the ad; you post it, or ask us to post it for you.
status.selfPostSub: Free. Vacantless writes the ad and keeps your link; you post it from your own {name} account.

stage1.igNote: Needs a Facebook Page with a linked Instagram Business account.

reason.cloudflare: the site asked for a human check
reason.captcha: the site asked for a human check

cap.kijijiTierUnknown: Tell us if this is a personal or business Kijiji account.
cap.rentalsReached: Free cap reached: 3 of 3 active. Disable one or pay for a plan.
cap.rentalsUnknown: Free (Limited): up to 3 active listings per account.
cap.zumperReached: Free cap reached: 5 of 5 listings. Remove one first.
cap.zumperUnknown: Free: up to 5 listings per account.

cost.kijijiTierUnknown: Tell us if this is a personal or business Kijiji account.
cost.kijijiNext: Free. The next ad after it is {price}.
cost.kijijiPerAd: {price} per ad, paid at the last step.
cost.kijijiPerExtraAd: {price} per extra ad, paid at the last step.
cost.spendSuffix: Set a spend limit before a paid post.

stage2.title: Add property details
stage2.sub: Give us the details one time. We fill every website for you. Pick one way to start.
stage2.cardEmailBody: Send any notes or a draft to your private Vacantless address.
stage2.cardDocBody: Drag in an old lease, a PDF brochure, or an MLS sheet.
stage2.cardManualBody: Fill a simple form by hand.
stage2.readTitle: What the computer has read so far
stage2.pickPrompt: Pick one way to start above, and the details will appear here.

stage3.title: Choose & send live
stage3.sub: Review once, then open the send page to post to each connected website.
stage3.onlyLinked: We only send to the websites you have linked. The rest stay off until they are ready.
stage3.blast: CLICK HERE TO SEND THIS LISTING TO ALL PORTALS NOW
stage3.sending: Sending now — please keep this screen open
stage3.allDone: All done. Your listing is live everywhere it can be.

stage4.title: After it is live
stage4.sub: This is what publish-only tools cannot show you: the leads coming back to one place, and the option to have each ad come down automatically once the home is leased.
stage4.leadsBody: Every reply from every website comes back to one place.
stage4.takedownBody: When the home is leased, Vacantless can take each ad down for you, so no ad is left live by mistake.
stage4.markLeasedHint: This turns on soon. For now, mark the home leased from its property page.
stage4.leasedDone: Leased. Your tracked ads are marked removed.
